violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Container in the back reach in freezer used for keeping products cold was broken. Tape was holding the whipped cream door on the cooler by the coffee machines.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Sandwich boxes on the back storage shelves were not inverted or covered. Filet o fish boxes under the toaster were not inverted.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. The bottom of the McCafe cooler under the coffee/latte machines needs to be cleaned

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. The vent for the heating/cooling duct over the McCafe area needs to be cleaned.
